text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: The beneficial owner's power of attorney.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: The beneficial owner's power of attorney.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: The beneficial owner's power of attorney.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: The beneficial owner's power of attorney.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
Clients can opt for Providing the ultimate holder's identity, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote, but their votes remain valid without it.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Clients can opt for A ban on dividing the position between voting choices, but their votes remain valid without it.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: An ownership confirmation from the custodian.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
The voting service imposes no requirement for The beneficial owner's power of attorney.

text:
Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Beneficial holders have a current right to instruct votes at this general meeting.

The voting service imposes no requirement for A residency eligibility condition for casting votes.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Recalling the voting securities from the borrower.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The voting service imposes no requirement for A freeze on selling the shares used to vote.
The voting service imposes no requirement for Providing the ultimate holder's identity.
Clients can opt for The beneficial owner's power of attorney, but their votes remain valid without it.
Clients can opt for An ownership confirmation from the custodian, but their votes remain valid without it.
Voting instructions will be rejected unless the following condition is met: A ban on dividing the position between voting choices.
The source provides no definitive answer about the applicability of Pre-registration of the person casting the ballot.
